test.summary: Timebox schedule - Generation of timebox schedule based on Jira sprints

steps.action:
Navigate to App Settings → Administration → Timebox schedules.

Click on Create Timebox schedule tile.
steps.result:
Create new timebox schedule dialog is appearing.

There are following fields:

* Name (no placeholder)
* Description (no placeholder)
* Timebox levels (placeholder: Select timebox levels)
* Start date (filled with today’s date)
* Connect Global Teams (placeholder: Select global teams)

Between Description and Timebox levels fields there is turned off toggle button: Use existing Jira sprints to generate a timebox schedule

All fields besides Description and Connect Global Teams are required and are marked by red star.

At the bottom there are two buttons: Cancel (enabled) and Create (disabled)

steps.action: Click on toggle button: Use existing Jira sprints to generate a timebox schedule
steps.result:
Start date field is not displaying anymore.

In Timebox levels is displaying timeboxLevel.

Timebox levels field is disabled and greyed out.

Under the field there is communicate:

Only one timebox level is allowed when Jira sync is enabled

steps.action: Provide scheduleName1 in Name field and click on Create.
steps.result:
User navigate to the timebox schedule details.

Synchronize sprints page is visible.

There are Board selector and disabled Save button.

steps.action: Click on Board selector, search and select jiraBoard.
steps.result:

* Ready to synchronize
